notes.title: March Updates – Self Realization & Identity in Asphodelium
notes.content:
Hi everyone, it’s the end of March! We’ve already been over some of the progress for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3072470/view/541100157904618577]Crimson Waves on the Emerald Sea: Amaranthine Moon[/url], so today we’re going to be looking at the progress for Asphodelium.

A major component of Asphodelium is self realization and discovering yourself, which wasn’t something I was able to dive deep into in the original release. The main character Hazel is a trans man who has lived as a man the past 2 years, but has hit a rut in his life because of his adventures. Depression and a lack of aspirations have taken a hold of him, preventing him from focusing on his future.

Similarly, the love interest Aster has to tackle his own identity problems, believing that he’s the doppelganger of the man you killed. While Hazel’s depression will be a point in the new scenes, today I want to look at Aster’s identity and how that relates to the player.

The upcoming extended edition will include a new storyline with new endings, but will also include new scenes for the existing storyline. One of these scenes will focus on how Hazel—how you—perceive Aster. Aster believes he’s a doppelganger, but what do you believe? Even if you believe that’s not the truth, does it matter to you? I want to allow players to consider who Aster is and whether that matters or not. These choices will impact the ending, which can have slight variations or entirely different endings. Will you help Aster in his own self realization and come to terms with your new future, or will you both fail to understand each other?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45130220/d46058f803f64c18bfc9d74f8632f67d9aa714ec.png[/img]

Names, personality, ambitions – they’re all important aspects to our personal identities, but those identities vary on how you perceive a person. There’s the identity that we each have, and the perceived identity that others see & interpret from us. I hope these concepts will make sense in the full game!

That being said, I was able to script several more scenes in the new storyline this month. The screenshot about is from one of those scenes, where I added a few more romantic moments in the later half of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45130220/e6b1ae04fe0fd7510d51ec15273199bdeab51b2d.png[/img]

The full extended cut will be releasing in June, with almost double the word count, lots of new endings, and brand new CGs. Wishlist it to support the development!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3139260/Asphodelium/

— Arimia

notes.title: January Update – Asphodelium Writing & Art
notes.content:
It’s the start of the new year and here’s the first devlog of the year!

After releasing [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2396400/Canvas_Menagerie/]Canvas Menagerie[/url] in December, we’re now focused on our otome sequel game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3072470/Crimson_Waves_on_the_Emerald_Sea_Amaranthine_Moon/]Crimson Waves on the Emerald Sea: Amaranthine Moon[/url] and an extended version of our melancholic BL [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3139260/Asphodelium/]Asphodelium[/url]. To better give updates on both of these projects, we’ll be doing 2 devlogs a month. At the middle of the month will be a devlog on Asphodelium (you’re here!) and at the end of the month will be for CWES: Amaranthine Moon.

Now that that’s out of the way, let’s take a look at Asphodelium!

Asphodelium’s 1.0 version was released a year ago in January 2024. If you’re unfamiliar with the game, it’s a melancholic lite horror boys love visual novel about cults, killing, and killing cults. And being gay.

You can see a preview of the current build here:
[previewyoutube=IE97OpuIiYM;full][/previewyoutube]

The January 2024 release included an entire storyline over 40k words and was considered “complete”. However, a few months later I realized there were more topics and ideas I wanted to explore in the story, and began writing an extended version of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45130220/13003f09227378c2b5744cc5601e6e1d3ee49e42.png[/img]

And now, the extended script has passed 19k words, bringing the total of the game close to 60k! I aim to write at least 6k more for this extended version and possibly more, depending on how long the new ending takes.

This extended version has a new storyline with a new ending as well as new scenes that will play out on both storylines. I hope it’ll give players a new look at Hazel & Aster’s relationship!

To go with the extended version, it’ll have brand new artwork such as several new CGs! The original version of the game only has 3, whereas the extended version will have several more, like this one of Hazel and Aster in the marketplace.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45130220/6df9c9a8942726c3210d1a172316ed1e19f2b22b.jpg[/img]

I also got my first acrylic standees for my games, including [url=https://ko-fi.com/s/955e7cb676]this one of Aster from the key visual[/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45130220/ff810ed3ac3f3981a10a97624c418daf6b6358d5.jpg[/img]

Once this extended version is complete, it will be $9.99 on Steam & itchio and the previous build will be taken down. If you want to play the current version of Asphodelium, it’s available as a demo on Steam & itchio. Also consider wishlisting is on Steam, as it’ll help very much!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3139260/Asphodelium/

— Arimia

notes.title: Season of Pride + Extended Edition Announcement!
notes.content:
Today marks the beginning of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/MidBoss/sale/SeasonOfPride2024]Season of Pride[/url] presented by MidBoss, IDGA, and Gayming Magazine! It's a festival celebrating a variety of queer games, including visual novels... like these!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/MidBoss/sale/SeasonOfPride2024][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45130220/aab0e4bb3bc37256bae1399b0190be747a20f493.png[/img][/url]

Together with some friends we're celebrating queer visual novels in the festival. Check them out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2231680/Of_Sense_and_Soul/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2993720/Cage_of_Roses/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1803850/Lock__Key_A_Magical_Girl_Mystery/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1652580/Imperial_Grace/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2396400/Canvas_Menagerie/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2537980/Drculeti/

Which brings us to our announcement...

[h2]Asphodelium is getting an extended version next year! 🎉[/h2]

Asphodelium is a complete experience right now, but we want to go even further with the themes in the story and create a branching narrative. This extended version will also include a lot more artwork, like this new CG!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45130220/6df9c9a8942726c3210d1a172316ed1e19f2b22b.jpg[/img]

For now, you can play an entire storyline for free in the demo. Once the extended version comes out next year, this demo won't be available.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3141490/Asphodelium_Demo/
